ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Moss reads your date of birth, sex, height and weight from Apple Health to set your targets; your steps, water, mindful minutes and sleep to light up those habits and estimate your night if you don’t wear a watch; and your nighttime heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability and respiratory rate for the Sleep section. Moss never writes to Apple Health.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Moss never writes to Apple Health: it only reads the data above.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Moss uses the camera to scan the barcode or nutrition label of what you eat, and to take a meal photo if you want one. Labels are read on your phone, and Moss never uploads your photos.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: If you don’t wear a watch, Moss looks at your phone’s activity (still, walking or driving) to estimate when you fell asleep and woke up. That activity never leaves your phone: only the estimated times are saved.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Moss uses the microphone only while you say what you ate, to log it. Moss never saves the audio.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Moss turns what you say about your meal into text to log it, using Apple's speech recognition (on your phone when the language allows it). Moss never saves the audio.
